title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: transcript_4 parameter named ciphertext_3 but receives PLAINTEXT_3
description:
## Summary
The `transcript_4` function at `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:542` has its second parameter named `ciphertext_3`, but per RFC 9528 Section 4.1, TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I). Both call sites (lines 1201 and 1631) pass PLAINTEXT_3. The parameter name `ciphertext_3` is misleading.

## Severity
P3 — readability/naming. No behavioral impact.

## Fix
Rename parameter `ciphertext_3` to `plaintext_3` in the `transcript_4` function signature and its internal usage on line 547.
